developers: Sebastian Larsson; Andrea Harty; Hampus Melin ; Isabelle Neuman; Luiza Flores da Cunha
short_description: Drill Bird is a cozy-yet-tense digging platformer where every trip underground counts. Play as a bird fallen from the sky, in search for powerful ores to hatch your Egg. Get home before night falls, upgrade abilities, grow stronger, and unfold a sincere bird story about survival, care and purpose.
